title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
title_zh: AnyGameRenderer：跨游戏且实体一致的生成式渲染及实体级基准

paragraphs.en: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity’s position and timing intact. Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners. AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input. It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame. We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses ∼ \sim 10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection. To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9% to 62.9%, missed count changes fall from 34.7% to 21.3%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.
paragraphs.zh: AI 编程智能体现在可以在几分钟内构建出小型可玩游戏，但结果通常看起来像是程序员美术：灰色白盒、彩色几何图元以及扁平的语义色块。 我们提出 AnyGameRenderer，一种视频到视频的生成式渲染器，可将此类画面转化为具有角色、运动细节和特效的高质量视觉效果。 在整个过程中，它保持布局、相机以及每个实体的位置和时序完好无损。 我们的 AnyGameRenderer 可以泛化到智能体构建的多种游戏类型，例如塔防、自动战斗、俯视角生存、回合制战斗、卡丁车竞速和人群跑酷。 AnyGameRenderer 以普通视频作为其游戏状态输入，无需引擎 G-buffer、逐物体类别标签或低多边形代理等复杂表示。 灰色白盒、彩色图元、语义图和线框图都可以作为输入。 它还能保持实体对应关系：群体数量保持正确，实体在正确的帧出现和消失。 我们通过对 MiniMax-H3 ref2va（一个 33B 的参考视频条件视频生成模型）进行 LoRA 微调来实现 AnyGameRenderer。 训练使用约 1 万对来自三个来源的配对片段：(i) 来自 GEAR（一款 AI 游戏创作工具）导出的 38 款智能体制作游戏的多流渲染数据；(ii) 来自虚幻引擎的双流渲染数据，带有程序化控制的群体、数量变化和实体缩放；以及 (iii) 真实游戏录像，通过 3D 框检测重建配对。 为了评估实体对应关系，我们提出了一个实体级基准，包含 59 个保留测试用例和 753 个实体，并以真值框进行评分。 与基础模型相比，AnyGameRenderer 更好地保持了实体对应关系：时序匹配率从 50.9% 提升到 62.9%，漏检的数量变化从 34.7% 下降到 21.3%，幻觉实体和未被渲染的实体也更少。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents and tools, such as GEAR [ 1 ] game-creation system, can now turn a one-paragraph prompt into a playable game in minutes, complete with game logic, physics, camera, win conditions, and working HUD [ 7 ] . What they cannot produce is good art. The output usually contains gray boxes, colored cylinders, and cones on flat-shaded ground. Human studios spend months replacing this kind of “programmer art” through modeling, texturing, and lighting. Splitting a game into an engine that manages state and a generative model that renders pixels has quickly become a common idea. Concurrent systems such as CWM [ 8 ] , PWM [ 15 ] , Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 32 ] , StreamRender-H3 [ 29 ] , Marionette [ 26 ] , and SolarRenderer [ 33 ] all adopt it in some form. We do not argue for this setting. Instead, we build a rendering layer that is more general in what it accepts and more faithful in what it keeps.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , AnyGameRenderer takes a crude gameplay recording and a text prompt (optionally with a style anchor image), and outputs the same gameplay re-rendered in the prompted style, frame-aligned with the input. It adds characters, motion detail, and effects, while keeping the layout, camera, and every entity’s position and timing. This brings two practical benefits. A game can easily switch to a new visual style by changing only the prompt. It also makes vibe gaming faster, since a game only needs code and a blockout, without modeling, texturing or animation.
paragraphs.zh: 如图1所示，AnyGameRenderer接收一段粗糙的游戏录屏和一个文本提示（可选附带一张风格锚定图像），输出以提示风格重新渲染的同一段游戏画面，并与输入逐帧对齐。 它会添加角色、动作细节和特效，同时保持布局、镜头以及每个实体的位置和时序。 这带来了两个实用好处。 游戏只需更改提示，即可轻松切换到新的视觉风格。 它还让氛围游戏（vibe gaming）更快，因为游戏只需要代码和一个粗模（blockout），无需建模、贴图或动画。

paragraphs.en: There are three properties that set AnyGameRenderer apart. (1) It generalizes across genres. Prior and concurrent works are demonstrated mainly on third-person, first-person, or driving footage, with limited coverage of the genres that agents actually produce. As illustrated in Figure 1 , AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres, including tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, crowd runners, arena survival, co-op games, and shooters. In addition, it accepts diverse input types, including gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, wireframes, and coarse mockup.
paragraphs.zh: 有三个特性使 AnyGameRenderer 与众不同。 （1）它能够跨游戏类型泛化。 已有的先行工作与同期工作主要在第三人称、第一人称或驾驶画面上进行演示，对智能体实际产出的游戏类型覆盖有限。 如图 1 所示，AnyGameRenderer 可跨多种游戏类型泛化，包括塔防、自动战斗、俯视角生存、回合制战斗、卡丁车竞速、人群奔跑、竞技场生存、合作游戏和射击游戏。 此外，它接受多种输入类型，包括灰色白模、彩色几何体、语义图、线框图和粗略模型样稿。

paragraphs.en: (2) It keeps entity correspondence. The hard part of game rendering is bookkeeping: twelve enemies become nine when three die; a reinforcement wave walks in at t = 4.2 t{=}4.2 s; a tiny far-away mob must not dissolve into fog. AnyGameRenderer substantially improves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, entities appear and disappear on the right frame, and fewer small entities are lost. The zero-shot base model often fails here: entities never appear, colored blocks stay unrendered, and characters appear even when they are not in the input.

paragraphs.en: To achieve these properties, we build paired (crude video, styled video) data from three sources. (i) GEAR’s multi-stream rendering data covers 38 agent-made games, helping the model generalize across genres and input types. (ii) Two-stream rendering in Unreal Engine uses scenes scripted with same-color groups that change count mid-clip, entity sizes from 20 to 600 px, and frame-aligned appearance and disappearance, teaching the model to keep entity correspondence. (iii) Real gameplay recordings, converted into crude inputs by 3D-box detection, help the model render realistic scenes. Together they yield 10,330 training clips.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现这些特性，我们从三个来源构建了配对的（粗糙视频、风格化视频）数据。 (i) GEAR 的多流渲染数据覆盖 38 款由智能体制作的游戏，帮助模型在不同游戏类型和输入类型之间泛化。 (ii) Unreal Engine 中的双流渲染使用以脚本编写的场景，其中包含在片段中途改变数量的同色组、20 到 600 px 的实体尺寸，以及帧对齐的出现与消失，从而教会模型保持实体的对应关系。 (iii) 真实游戏录像通过 3D 框检测转换为粗糙输入，帮助模型渲染逼真的场景。 三者合计产生 10,330 个训练片段。

sents.zh: (iii) 真实游戏录像通过 3D 框检测转换为粗糙输入，帮助模型渲染逼真的场景。

sents.en: Together they yield 10,330 training clips.
sents.zh: 三者合计产生 10,330 个训练片段。

paragraphs.en: Existing renderers are evaluated at the frame level, with edge agreement, point tracks, or pairwise judges, which cannot tell whether each entity is rendered correctly. We therefore design an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, each annotated with ground-truth boxes, and evaluate it with four metrics. Temporal match measures whether each entity appears and disappears on time; position match measures whether it stays at the right place; unrendered rate measures how often crude input blocks are left unrendered; and hallucination rate measures how often the output contains entities that do not exist in the input. Compared with the zero-shot base, AnyGameRenderer raises temporal match from 50.9% to 62.9% and position match from 57.1% to 61.9%, and lowers the unrendered rate from 4.1% to 2.9% and the hallucination rate from 52.1% to 46.0%.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的渲染器在帧级别上进行评估，采用边缘一致性、点轨迹或成对评判者，无法判断每个实体是否被正确渲染。 因此，我们设计了一个实体级别的基准，包含59个保留案例和753个实体，每个实体都标注了真实边界框，并用四项指标进行评估。 时间匹配衡量每个实体是否按时出现和消失；位置匹配衡量它是否停留在正确的位置；未渲染率衡量粗糙输入块有多少次未被渲染；幻觉率衡量输出中有多少次包含输入中不存在的实体。 与零样本基线相比，AnyGameRenderer 将时间匹配从50.9%提升到62.9%，位置匹配从57.1%提升到61.9%，并将未渲染率从4.1%降低到2.9%，幻觉率从52.1%降低到46.0%。

paragraphs.en: Early work uses large language models to generate game content such as levels and rules. MarioGPT [ 34 ] generates Super Mario Bros. levels from text, Word2World [ 28 ] turns stories into playable 2D tile worlds, and LLMGG [ 13 ] generates game rules and levels in the Video Game Description Language. Multi-agent frameworks such as GameGPT [ 6 ] split game development into roles that collaborate on a full project. More recently, coding agents build complete games end-to-end. Recursive Game Creator [ 7 ] iterates designer, builder, player and reviewer roles over HTML and Godot projects; OpenGame [ 17 ] is an open-source agentic framework for web games across genres such as action and tower defense; and GEAR [ 1 ] turns a short prompt into a playable game in minutes. While these systems produce working game logic, their visuals are usually limited to simple shapes and placeholder assets, far from the art quality of commercial games.
paragraphs.zh: 早期工作利用大语言模型生成关卡和规则等游戏内容。 MarioGPT [ 34 ] 根据文本生成《超级马里奥兄弟》关卡，Word2World [ 28 ] 将故事转化为可玩的 2D 瓦片世界，LLMGG [ 13 ] 在视频游戏描述语言中生成游戏规则和关卡。 诸如 GameGPT [ 6 ] 之类的多智能体框架将游戏开发拆分为多个角色，在一个完整项目中协作。 最近，编码智能体可以端到端地构建完整的游戏。 Recursive Game Creator [ 7 ] 在 HTML 和 Godot 项目上迭代设计师、构建者、玩家和评审者等角色；OpenGame [ 17 ] 是一个面向动作、塔防等多种类型网页游戏的开源智能体框架；GEAR [ 1 ] 能在几分钟内将简短的提示词转化为可玩的游戏。 虽然这些系统能产出可运行的游戏逻辑，但其视觉表现通常仅限于简单形状和占位素材，与商业游戏的美术品质相去甚远。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work replaces the game engine altogether: an autoregressive video model, conditioned on player actions, generates the next frames. Examples include Genie [ 4 , 30 , 2 ] , GameNGen [ 36 ] , Oasis [ 9 ] , MineWorld [ 11 ] , GameGen-X [ 5 ] , GameFactory [ 41 ] , Hunyuan-GameCraft [ 18 , 35 ] , the Matrix-Game line [ 12 , 37 , 10 ] , and Yume [ 25 , 24 ] . These models are strong simulators but hard to control in the ways a game needs: exact entity counts, scripted events, and rules that hold for minutes. Long-horizon memory [ 39 , 40 , 38 , 22 ] reduces drift but does not make the world programmable.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线完全取代了游戏引擎：一个以玩家动作为条件的自回归视频模型来生成后续帧。 例子包括 Genie [ 4 , 30 , 2 ] 、GameNGen [ 36 ] 、Oasis [ 9 ] 、MineWorld [ 11 ] 、GameGen-X [ 5 ] 、GameFactory [ 41 ] 、Hunyuan-GameCraft [ 18 , 35 ] 、Matrix-Game 系列 [ 12 , 37 , 10 ] 以及 Yume [ 25 , 24 ] 。 这些模型是强大的模拟器，但难以按游戏所需的方式进行控制：精确的实体数量、脚本化事件，以及能持续数分钟保持有效的规则。 长时程记忆 [ 39 , 40 , 38 , 22 ] 能减少漂移，但无法让世界变得可编程。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work keeps the engine in charge of game state and uses a generative model only to render pixels. Neural forward rendering from G-buffers [ 19 , 3 , 42 , 23 ] and earlier generative world renderers [ 16 , 20 ] follow this split, but require engine-exact inputs. Several concurrent systems extend it to crude inputs that a game or an agent can produce cheaply. CWM [ 8 ] lets a coding agent maintain world state and renders a 12-class proxy video with a MiniMax-H3 LoRA. PWM [ 15 ] converts real AAA recordings into state-augmented 3D oriented boxes and renders them with a structured spatial ControlNet on a frozen backbone. Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 32 ] renders low-poly engine proxies in real time with a distilled causal DiT. StreamRender-H3 [ 29 ] streams a 13-class semantic map into video. SolarRenderer [ 33 ] trains a control LoRA on a frozen MiniMax-H3 with six types of structural video, passes them without type labels, and generalizes to structure types unseen in training; it also renders in four steps and supports streaming.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的工作让引擎负责游戏状态，仅使用生成模型来渲染像素。 基于 G-buffer 的神经前向渲染 [ 19 , 3 , 42 , 23 ] 以及更早的生成式世界渲染器 [ 16 , 20 ] 都遵循这种划分，但需要与引擎完全一致的输入。 若干同期工作将其扩展到游戏或智能体可以低成本产生的粗糙输入。 CWM [ 8 ] 让一个编程智能体维护世界状态，并用 MiniMax-H3 LoRA 渲染 12 类代理视频。 PWM [ 15 ] 将真实的 AAA 游戏录像转换为带状态增广的 3D 朝向包围盒，并在冻结骨干上用结构化空间 ControlNet 进行渲染。 Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 32 ] 用蒸馏后的因果 DiT 实时渲染低多边形引擎代理。 StreamRender-H3 [ 29 ] 将 13 类语义图流式输入以生成视频。 SolarRenderer [ 33 ] 在冻结的 MiniMax-H3 上用六种结构化视频训练控制 LoRA，输入时不带类型标签，并能泛化到训练中未见过的结构类型；它还能以四步完成渲染并支持流式处理。

paragraphs.en: AnyGameRenderer differs from these systems in three ways. First, they are demonstrated mainly on realistic third-person, driving, or a few self-built 3D scenes; our method generalizes across a wide range of genres, including tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, crowd runners, arena survival, co-op games, and shooters. Second, many of them rely on a fixed intermediate representation, while we take plain video. Third, none of them measures entity-level correspondence. Frame-level metrics barely change when a small entity is missing or a group arrives late, and edge agreement even rewards leaving crude blocks unrendered. We make correspondence, including the count, timing and position of every entity, the main target of both training data and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: AnyGameRenderer 与这些系统有三点不同。 首先，这些系统主要在写实风格的第三人称、驾驶或少量自建的 3D 场景中演示；而我们的方法能泛化到广泛的题材，包括塔防、自动战斗、俯视角幸存者、回合制战斗、卡丁车竞速、人潮跑酷、竞技场生存、合作游戏和射击游戏。 其次，其中许多依赖于固定的中间表示，而我们采用普通视频。 第三，它们都没有度量实体级的对应关系。 当一个小实体缺失或一组实体延迟出现时，帧级指标几乎不变，而边缘一致性甚至会奖励保留未渲染的粗糙方块。 我们把对应关系（包括每个实体的数量、时机和位置）作为训练数据和评估的主要目标。

paragraphs.en: Let V in ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 V_{\mathrm{in}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} be a crude gameplay clip and c c be a text prompt describing the target style and what each crude entity represents. AnyGameRenderer produces V out V_{\mathrm{out}} of the same length and resolution such that (i) camera, layout, and timing match V in V_{\mathrm{in}} frame by frame; (ii) every crude entity becomes its finished counterpart at the same position, apparent size, and heading, appearing and disappearing on the same frames; and (iii) appearance, including materials, lighting, character design, and environment, follows c c and an optional anchor image I a I_{\mathrm{a}} .

paragraphs.en: We build on the ref2va mode of MiniMax-H3 [ 27 ] , which edits a reference video according to a text prompt. We pass the crude clip as <Video 1> and describe the target rendering in the prompt, so any crude input works. The model runs at 24 fps up to 768p. We disable the audio loss in training and discard audio at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MiniMax-H3 [27] 的 ref2va 模式基础上进行构建，该模式根据文本提示编辑参考视频。 我们将粗剪片段作为 <Video 1> 传入，并在提示中描述目标渲染效果，因此任何粗剪输入都可以使用。 该模型以 24 fps 运行，最高支持 768p。 我们在训练中禁用音频损失，并在推理时丢弃音频。

sents.en: We build on the ref2va mode of MiniMax-H3 [ 27 ] , which edits a reference video according to a text prompt.
sents.zh: 我们在 MiniMax-H3 [27] 的 ref2va 模式基础上进行构建，该模式根据文本提示编辑参考视频。

sents.en: We pass the crude clip as <Video 1> and describe the target rendering in the prompt, so any crude input works.

sents.zh: 我们在训练中禁用音频损失，并在推理时丢弃音频。

paragraphs.en: Each sample has three conditions: 1) the crude clip as reference video <Video 1> ; 2) a six-segment structured caption ( Section 3.2 ); and 3) an optional anchor image. During training, the anchor is the target’s first frame; at inference, it serves as a style reference or is omitted. The crude clip fixes the structure, while the caption and anchor set the style. To render the same clip in a new style, we only change the prompt or the anchor.
paragraphs.zh: 每个样本包含三个条件：1) 作为参考视频的粗剪片段 <Video 1>；2) 六段式结构化字幕（见 3.2 节）；3) 一张可选的锚点图像。 在训练时，锚点是目标视频的首帧；在推理时，它可作为风格参考，也可省略。 粗剪片段确定结构，而字幕和锚点设定风格。 若要以新风格渲染同一片段，我们只需更改提示词或锚点。

sents.en: Each sample has three conditions: 1) the crude clip as reference video <Video 1> ; 2) a six-segment structured caption ( Section 3.2 ); and 3) an optional anchor image.
sents.zh: 每个样本包含三个条件：1) 作为参考视频的粗剪片段 <Video 1>；2) 六段式结构化字幕（见 3.2 节）；3) 一张可选的锚点图像。

paragraphs.en: We train a LoRA [ 14 ] of rank 128 on all transformer blocks with the standard flow-matching objective [ 21 ] , keeping the base weights frozen. All reported results use 20-step Euler sampling on base + + LoRA.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在所有 transformer 块上以标准流匹配目标 [ 21 ] 训练一个秩为 128 的 LoRA [ 14 ] ，并保持基础权重冻结。 所有报告的结果均在 base + + LoRA 上使用 20 步 Euler 采样。

sents.en: We train a LoRA [ 14 ] of rank 128 on all transformer blocks with the standard flow-matching objective [ 21 ] , keeping the base weights frozen.
sents.zh: 我们在所有 transformer 块上以标准流匹配目标 [ 21 ] 训练一个秩为 128 的 LoRA [ 14 ] ，并保持基础权重冻结。

sents.en: All reported results use 20-step Euler sampling on base + + LoRA.
sents.zh: 所有报告的结果均在 base + + LoRA 上使用 20 步 Euler 采样。

paragraphs.en: We keep the base model’s six-segment format ( subject_definitions , summary , retention_analysis , detailed_description , overall_soundscape , non_diegetic_music ) and follow four rules, which we call the correspondence contract.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留基础模型的六段式格式（subject_definitions、summary、retention_analysis、detailed_description、overall_soundscape、non_diegetic_music），并遵循四条规则，我们将其称为对应契约（correspondence contract）。

paragraphs.en: Each subject is defined as the real entity, and the crude input is named as its representation, e.g., “ every blue ellipsoid in <Video 1> is one raccoon-like orchard raider, and the whole blue group is a group of identical ones .” The color-to-identity mapping is set per clip, groups are described at class level with explicit statements that they exist.
paragraphs.zh: 每个主体被定义为真实实体，而原始输入被称为其表示，例如：“<Video 1> 中的每个蓝色椭球体都是一个类似浣熊的果园掠夺者，整个蓝色群体是一组相同的个体。”颜色到身份的映射按片段设置，群体在类级别上进行描述，并明确声明它们的存在。

paragraphs.en: This segment declares position, apparent size, timing, and head count as preserved exactly, and leaves appearance to the prompt. It also describes empty space positively: “areas empty in <Video 1> stay empty; no character is added that has no primitive in <Video 1> .”
paragraphs.zh: 该片段声明将位置、表观大小、时机和头部数量精确保留，并将外观留给提示词处理。 它还对空白区域作了正面描述：“<Video 1> 中空白的区域保持空白；不会添加在 <Video 1> 中没有原始元素的角色。”

sents.en: This segment declares position, apparent size, timing, and head count as preserved exactly, and leaves appearance to the prompt.
sents.zh: 该片段声明将位置、表观大小、时机和头部数量精确保留，并将外观留给提示词处理。

sents.en: It also describes empty space positively: “areas empty in <Video 1> stay empty; no character is added that has no primitive in <Video 1> .”
sents.zh: 它还对空白区域作了正面描述：“<Video 1> 中空白的区域保持空白；不会添加在 <Video 1> 中没有原始元素的角色。”

paragraphs.en: The base model has no negative prompt, and negative phrasing tends to produce what it names (“no HUD” reliably produces a HUD). All captions are therefore written as positive statements.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型没有负面提示词，负面表述往往会生成其所命名的内容（“no HUD” 会稳定地生成一个 HUD）。 因此，所有说明文字均以肯定语句的形式编写。

sents.en: The base model has no negative prompt, and negative phrasing tends to produce what it names (“no HUD” reliably produces a HUD).
sents.zh: 基础模型没有负面提示词，负面表述往往会生成其所命名的内容（“no HUD” 会稳定地生成一个 HUD）。

sents.en: All captions are therefore written as positive statements.
sents.zh: 因此，所有说明文字均以肯定语句的形式编写。

paragraphs.en: Captions are generated automatically from engine metadata and detection results, not written by hand. Each caption lists every character that may appear in the game, even if some never show up in the clip. We keep this noise on purpose: it teaches the model to decide what exists from the video, not from the text. As a result, the model rarely adds characters that are named in the caption but missing from the input.
paragraphs.zh: 字幕由引擎元数据和检测结果自动生成，而非人工撰写。 每条字幕都会列出游戏中可能出现的所有角色，即使某些角色从未在片段中出现。 我们有意保留这种噪声：它教会模型根据视频而非文本来判断什么存在。 因此，该模型很少添加字幕中出现但输入中缺失的角色。

paragraphs.en: All sources are resampled to 124-frame clips at 24 fps (5.17 s) and 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 , with the target’s first frame as the anchor and a silent 32 kHz audio track. Latents and text embeddings are cached once per source.
paragraphs.zh: 所有源素材均重采样为124帧、24 fps（5.17秒）、1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 的片段，以目标的首帧作为锚点，并配有静音的32 kHz音轨。 潜变量和文本嵌入在每个源上仅缓存一次。

sents.en: All sources are resampled to 124-frame clips at 24 fps (5.17 s) and 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 , with the target’s first frame as the anchor and a silent 32 kHz audio track.
sents.zh: 所有源素材均重采样为124帧、24 fps（5.17秒）、1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 的片段，以目标的首帧作为锚点，并配有静音的32 kHz音轨。

paragraphs.en: We train a rank-128 LoRA on all blocks with a global batch size of 16. The learning rate warms up over 100 steps and then follows a cosine decay, with a peak between 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} and 2.8 × 10 − 5 2.8{\times}10^{-5} ; weight decay is 0.01. We use bf16 precision, gradient checkpointing, and block swapping, while FlashAttention-3 [ 31 ] speeds up each step by about 30%. Training runs on 16 NVIDIA H200 GPUs (141 GB). Each step takes about 129 s, and three epochs over all 10,330 training clips take about 48 hours.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在所有模块上训练一个秩为 128 的 LoRA，全局批大小为 16。 学习率在 100 步内预热，随后按余弦衰减衰减，峰值介于 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} 与 2.8 × 10 − 5 2.8{\times}10^{-5} 之间；权重衰减为 0.01。 我们使用 bf16 精度、梯度检查点和模块交换，而 FlashAttention-3 [ 31 ] 将每一步的速度提升约 30%。 训练在 16 块 NVIDIA H200 GPU（141 GB）上运行。 每一步耗时约 129 秒，对全部 10,330 个训练片段进行三个轮次的训练约需 48 小时。

paragraphs.en: We use a LoRA multiplier of 1.0 for in-domain inputs and styles. For out-of-domain text-only styles (no anchor image, and a style unseen in training), a multiplier of 0.7 recovers the zero-shot visual quality while keeping the correspondence gains. We recommend it as the default for open-ended styling.
paragraphs.zh: 对于域内输入和风格，我们使用 1.0 的 LoRA 乘数。 对于域外的纯文本风格（无锚点图像，且该风格在训练中未见），0.7 的乘数在保持对应关系增益的同时恢复了零样本的视觉质量。 我们推荐将其作为开放式风格化的默认设置。

sents.zh: 对于域内输入和风格，我们使用 1.0 的 LoRA 乘数。

sents.zh: 我们推荐将其作为开放式风格化的默认设置。

paragraphs.en: We build (crude video, styled video) pairs from three sources: multi-stream rendering data from GEAR covers different genres and input types; two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine targets entity correspondence; and real gameplay recordings add realistic layouts, cameras, and motion. In every pair, the crude and styled videos share the same camera and layout and are frame-aligned by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个来源构建（粗糙视频、风格化视频）数据对：来自 GEAR 的多流渲染数据涵盖不同类型和输入方式；来自虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine）的双流渲染数据面向实体对应；真实的游戏实况录制则提供了真实的布局、镜头和运动。 在每一个数据对中，粗糙视频与风格化视频共享相同的镜头和布局，并且在构造上就是逐帧对齐的。

sents.zh: 我们从三个来源构建（粗糙视频、风格化视频）数据对：来自 GEAR 的多流渲染数据涵盖不同类型和输入方式；来自虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine）的双流渲染数据面向实体对应；真实的游戏实况录制则提供了真实的布局、镜头和运动。

paragraphs.en: GEAR [ 1 ] is a game-creation system that builds small games end-to-end from a prompt and can export different render passes from a running game. Our multi-stream rendering data uses 38 agent-made games, covering shooters, survivors, tower defense, kart racing, arena, and co-op designs. This source contributes 3,221 clips. Each clip has five aligned passes: the target render; a primitive pass, where the scene is a gray blockout and characters are simple geometric shapes; a coarse pass, with a more detailed blockout and low-poly clay figures; a 12-class semantic map; and depth. Each clip also comes with an anchor image, a caption, and 3D boxes. We train on the pair of primitive and target.
paragraphs.zh: GEAR [1] 是一个游戏创建系统，能够根据提示端到端地构建小型游戏，并可以从运行中的游戏导出不同的渲染通道。 我们的多流渲染数据使用了 38 个由智能体制作的游戏，涵盖射击、生存、塔防、卡丁车竞速、竞技场和合作类设计。 该数据源贡献了 3,221 个片段。 每个片段都有五个对齐的通道：目标渲染；原始通道，其中场景为灰色遮挡块、角色为简单几何形状；粗糙通道，具有更详细的遮挡块和低多边形黏土风格角色；12 类语义图；以及深度。 每个片段还附带一张锚点图像、一段说明文字和 3D 边界框。 我们在原始通道与目标通道的配对上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Each Unreal Engine scene uses two-stream rendering: it is rendered from the same simulation and camera as a gray blockout with colored blocks for characters and as a full render. The protagonist is always blue, and other characters use a six-color set.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 Unreal Engine 场景都采用双流渲染：即从同一模拟和相机分别渲染出两个版本——一个是以彩色块表示角色的灰色遮挡版，另一个是完整渲染版。 主角始终为蓝色，其他角色使用一组六种颜色。

sents.zh: 每个 Unreal Engine 场景都采用双流渲染：即从同一模拟和相机分别渲染出两个版本——一个是以彩色块表示角色的灰色遮挡版，另一个是完整渲染版。

paragraphs.en: Rather than collecting generic gameplay, we script scenes around the zero-shot failures (see examples in Figure 3 ) to ensure entity correspondence:

paragraphs.en: Following the reconstruction approach in PWM [ 15 ] , we convert real gameplay recordings of combat, driving, and pedestrian scenes into crude inputs. We detect 3D bounding boxes in each frame and render them over a checkerboard ground as proxies of varied shapes: solid boxes, wireframe boxes, cylinders, and upright ellipsoids, with about 800 clips per shape. The original recording is the target, and captions come from the detection labels plus one sentence describing the environment. This source adds real-world scenes, with realistic camera work and vehicle and pedestrian motion. It contributes 3,199 clips.
paragraphs.zh: 按照 PWM [15] 中的重建方法，我们将战斗、驾驶和行人场景的真实游戏录像转换为粗糙输入。 我们在每一帧中检测三维边界框，并将其渲染在棋盘格地面上，作为各种形状的代理：实心框、线框框、圆柱体和直立椭球体，每种形状约 800 个片段。 原始录像作为目标，字幕来自检测标签加上一句描述环境的句子。 该数据源增加了真实世界场景，具有真实的镜头运动以及车辆和行人动态。 它贡献了 3,199 个片段。

paragraphs.en: Input entities are the ground-truth 2D boxes shipped with each crude video; entities that exist for fewer than 12 frames are ignored. In the generated video, we locate characters with SAM3 open-vocabulary segmentation, prompted with the caption’s subject phrases plus generic person and vehicle terms. We remove shadow and reflection detections and link the remaining detections into tracks. In each frame, input boxes and detections are matched with the Hungarian method, and a pair is accepted only if IoU ≥ 0.3 {}\geq 0.3 or the centroid offset is within half the input box size. We report four main metrics, averaged over entities:

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows seven held-out cases. The zero-shot model works well on sparse scenes with clean captions, but on game footage it fails in three ways. First, it leaves crude shapes in the output: blue cubes in an orchard, cyan cylinders in an arena, and a blue cylinder in the grass where an elk should be. Second, it drops the input viewpoint when the style is far from typical game footage, turning a top-down blockout into a frontal anime group shot or a first-person Minecraft-like scene. Third, it adds characters named in the caption that have no block in the input. AnyGameRenderer fixes all three in these cases while keeping the prompted style.

paragraphs.en: A single checkpoint handles all five genres in our benchmark: first-person shooters, top-down, third-person, crowd, and vehicle games ( Figure 5 ). AnyGameRenderer improves temporal match over the zero-shot model in every genre, with the largest gains on crowd and third-person games. It also lowers the unrendered rate in every genre except crowd games, where both models are already near zero, and improves position match most on vehicle games. The hallucination rate falls on crowd games but rises slightly on top-down and third-person games. Top-down games remain the hardest, with low temporal match for both models.
paragraphs.zh: 单一检查点即可处理我们基准中的全部五种类型：第一人称射击、俯视角、第三人称、人群和载具类游戏（图 5）。 AnyGameRenderer 在每种类型上都比零样本模型提升了时间匹配度，其中在人群和第三人称类游戏上提升最大。 它还降低了除人群类游戏外所有类型的未渲染率——两类模型在人群类游戏上已接近于零——并在载具类游戏上对位置匹配度的提升最为显著。 幻觉率在人群类游戏上下降，但在俯视角和第三人称类游戏上略有上升。 俯视角类游戏仍然最难，两类模型在该类型上的时间匹配度都很低。

paragraphs.en: We presented AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns the programmer art of agent-made games into high-quality visuals. We train a single LoRA on MiniMax-H3, using paired data from GEAR’s multi-stream rendering, Unreal Engine’s two-stream rendering, and real gameplay recordings. The resulting checkpoint handles a wide range of genres. It takes plain video as input, from gray blockouts and colored primitives to semantic maps and wireframes. It also keeps entities in sync with the input. On a held-out benchmark, temporal match rises from 50.9% to 62.9%, and missed count changes fall from 34.7% to 21.3%. As coding agents build more and more games, we believe a general renderer that keeps every entity in place will help these games look as good as they play.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AnyGameRenderer，这是一个视频到视频的生成式渲染器，能将智能体制作游戏中的程序员美术风格画面转化为高质量视觉效果。 我们在 MiniMax-H3 上训练了一个 LoRA，使用来自 GEAR 的多流渲染、Unreal Engine 的双流渲染以及真实游戏录屏的配对数据。 由此得到的检查点能够应对广泛的题材类型。 它以普通视频作为输入，可以是灰色块状图、彩色几何图形，也可以是语义图和线框图。 它还能让实体与输入保持同步。 在一个保留测试基准上，时间匹配率从 50.9% 提升到 62.9%，漏计数量变化率从 34.7% 降到 21.3%。 随着编程智能体构建越来越多的游戏，我们相信一个能让每个实体都保持原位的通用渲染器，将帮助这些游戏在视觉效果上与玩法一样出色。
